interpretation: 80 proposed test families, not 80 independent corpora or executed benchmarks

tasks.T1: Complete ordered packed truth vector over a declared basis; full consumption required.
tasks.T2: Evaluation of specified concrete assignments/batches; return matching bits or output tuples.
tasks.T3: Scalar status, witness, ordinary count or projected count; each output subtype is a distinct cell.
tasks.T4: Session of explicitly typed queries; same ordered answers, preparation/cache lifetime and inputs.
tasks.T5: Equivalence status, counterexample or exact semantic-difference count; separate output subtypes.
tasks.T6: Complete ordered byte stream to a declared real sink, or explicitly declared cancellation prefix.
tasks.T7: Exact GF(2) rank, consistency, solution count, basis or full decomposition; separate subtypes.
tasks.T8: Simplified expression, synthesis artifact or historical boundary audit; quality guarantee explicit.
tasks.T9: Weighted count/probability under specified arithmetic, projection and error guarantees.
tasks.T10: Boolean set/bitmap query over arbitrary row IDs; distinct universe from complete assignments.

scale_profiles.small: 2,4,6,8; 10/12 only after timeout calibration; never force exponential minimization blindly to 32.
scale_profiles.explicit: 4,8,12,16,20,24,28,32 active/output variables when supported; bridge widths 18,22,26,30 optional.
scale_profiles.explicit_large: 20,24,28,30,32 with verified output/working-set admission and bounded complete streaming.
scale_profiles.native_plus_explicit: Whole source models at native size; explicit outputs only within admitted basis/byte limits; residuals separately labeled.
scale_profiles.symbolic: Whole input sizes including 32,64,128,256,1024+ variables where native algorithms and limits allow; no full expansion requirement.
scale_profiles.projection: Record total, visible and hidden widths independently; visible 8,12,16,20,24,28,32 plus whole-model scalar cases.
scale_profiles.weighted: Small audited encodings first; advance by encoded variables, factor width and arithmetic cost, not original node count.
scale_profiles.affine: 16,32,64,128,256,512,1024,4096 columns when limits allow; independently vary rows, rank and density.
scale_profiles.query: Q=1,2,4,8,16,64,256,1024; then observed trace Q. State width follows underlying input and resource limits.
scale_profiles.batch_rows: 8-128+ predicates; 1,32,1024,65536,1048576 actual rows/assignments where appropriate; rows are not 2^predicates.

required_controls.T1: CM full wrapper; optimized BitSet; sharing-aware CSE-flat; native/tiled words if verified; CUDD including full extraction; small SymPy table control.
required_controls.T2: Compiled direct/short-circuit evaluator; SymPy lambdify/NumPy; CSE-flat batch; admitted CM lookup/batch; relevant native application engine.
required_controls.T3: SAT: CaDiCaL/PySAT, Kissat one-shot, CryptoMiniSat for XOR. Counts: exact CUDD, d4, Ganak --prob 0, admitted CM scalar plans; projection capability checked.
required_controls.T4: Same task-specific controls with equivalent preparation, result caches, query assumptions, version invalidation and memory budgets.
required_controls.T5: SAT/ABC miter for status; packed XOR-popcount or exact projected counter for delta counts; CM matched output only.
required_controls.T6: CM and CSE-flat tiled stream plus complete-output delivery control; all methods include producer and final consumer costs.
required_controls.T7: Python packed Gaussian elimination; native M4RI; current CM-associated affine/decomposition path with all conversion charged.
required_controls.T8: SymPy simplify_logic explicit options; Espresso/ABC as suitable for declared quality; CM pipeline only if output guarantee is implemented.
required_controls.T9: Exact native counter/BDD weighted evaluation or native Bayesian/fault-tree engine; CM extension only after capability and precision validation.
required_controls.T10: CRoaring, dense words/bigint and sorted-list controls; CM/CSE batch adapter only after verifying arbitrary-row semantics.

tests.name: EPFL arithmetic cones
tests.proposed_test: Select adder, multiplier, divider, square-root and other arithmetic roots by a fixed hash within width strata.
tests.fairness_and_admission: Root/cone importer available in prior work; deduplicate designs and retain full-cone failures. A cut boundary is a derived abstraction.

tests.name: EPFL control cones
tests.proposed_test: Sample arbiter, router, voter, decoder and other control functions independently of timings.
tests.fairness_and_admission: Keep whole-design cluster identities; expose all tested roots, including constants and low-support roots.

tests.name: ISCAS85 combinational logic
tests.proposed_test: Use the canonical combinational circuits and stratified output cones from an attributed distribution.
tests.fairness_and_admission: Verify original provenance and per-file terms through IWLS/LogikBench lineage; historical engineering benchmarks are not traffic traces.

tests.name: ISCAS89 one-step logic
tests.proposed_test: Extract combinational next-state/output functions with current state explicitly declared as inputs.
tests.fairness_and_admission: One step does not establish reachability or sequential equivalence; initial-state assumptions must be recorded.

tests.name: IWLS2005 design suite
tests.proposed_test: Sample designs and combinational cones across gate count, depth and reconvergence.
tests.fairness_and_admission: Deduplicate shared ISCAS/ITC/OpenCores ancestry; do not count suite repackaging as new systems.

tests.name: VTR and Koios designs
tests.proposed_test: Select independent accelerator/control designs, then freeze bit-level cones and output groups.
tests.fairness_and_admission: Elaboration, memories, signedness and sequential boundaries need verified import; neural accelerator hardware is not a neural inference benchmark.

tests.name: Yosys large designs
tests.proposed_test: Use benchmarks_large designs unused in previous confirmation; retain synthesis and source identities.
tests.fairness_and_admission: Check elaboration against Yosys/ABC; preserving sharing is required in CM and CSE-flat alike.

tests.name: Yosys small mechanisms
tests.proposed_test: Use benchmarks_small arithmetic, mux and gate tests to isolate depth and sharing effects.
tests.fairness_and_admission: Upstream calls these mostly synthetic; retain that label and do not combine their weighting with real designs.

tests.name: Original versus synthesized equivalence
tests.proposed_test: Compare original/ABC-rewritten circuits and controlled one-gate mutations; return equivalent status or exact difference count.
tests.fairness_and_admission: Equivalent pairs must be certified and mutations may be semantically masked; count only verified non-equivalent pairs as negatives.

tests.name: Multi-output shared evaluation
tests.proposed_test: Request 1, 4, 16 and 64 outputs from one design, with one union basis and declared order.
tests.fairness_and_admission: All methods may share intermediates across roots; charge the sum of output bytes and multi-root preparation.

tests.name: Linux configuration formulas
tests.proposed_test: Select independent releases and whole models, plus separately labeled bounded residuals.
tests.fairness_and_admission: Original features and auxiliaries must be mapped; arbitrary clause deletion is not a valid residual.

tests.name: BusyBox version histories
tests.proposed_test: Use chronological versions and partial configurations; return feasibility, count and changed-product queries.
tests.fairness_and_admission: Split by system/history rather than rows; old consumed versions are regression evidence, not fresh confirmation.

tests.name: uClibc and Fiasco configurations
tests.proposed_test: Sample both systems and preserve source feature mappings and previously found counterexamples.
tests.fairness_and_admission: Full-CNF counts are separate from projected product counts; reject unsupported source semantics explicitly.

tests.name: eCos/CDL configurations
tests.proposed_test: Use available attributed Boolean models and natural component boundaries.
tests.fairness_and_admission: CDL attributes and non-Boolean constructs require a documented Boolean interpretation or refusal.

tests.name: Automotive and financial product models
tests.proposed_test: Select one or more models per independent product family, including finance history where available.
tests.fairness_and_admission: A model's domain label does not prove deployed use; preserve obfuscation and conversion metadata.

tests.name: Small SPLOT/UVL models
tests.proposed_test: Start with complete small models, stratified by hierarchy depth, constraints and valid-product density.
tests.fairness_and_admission: SPLOT contains community examples and synthetic models; classify origin individually and deduplicate other repositories.

tests.name: Smartwatch product evolution
tests.proposed_test: Compare available Mi Band model versions and reduced/realized/planned configurations.
tests.fairness_and_admission: These model kinds have different intended semantics; compare like kinds over time and preserve release ancestry.

tests.name: Interactive configurator sessions
tests.proposed_test: Generate backtracking, contradictory selections and correlated partial assignments over real product models.
tests.fairness_and_admission: Call modeled sessions synthetic unless an operator supplies real interactions; every method gets the same assumptions and reuse.

tests.name: Dead, core and optional features
tests.proposed_test: Return complete status vectors from repeated SAT assumptions and count-based checks where admitted.
tests.fairness_and_admission: Incremental native SAT keeps learned clauses; cache query results and report total feature-analysis time.

tests.name: Projected feature-product counts
tests.proposed_test: Count distinct concrete configurations after existential auxiliary elimination; include empty projection and unused features.
tests.fairness_and_admission: Projection-capable CM is reported in a separate checkout: locate and freeze it before admission; verify original conversion, not only DIMACS semantics.

tests.name: Application SAT and UNSAT
tests.proposed_test: Use a family-balanced subset of the SAT competition with descriptions, both outcomes, and unmodified whole inputs.
tests.fairness_and_admission: Native CDCL is mandatory. CM explicit refusal is a result; whole industrial CNFs can greatly exceed 32 variables.

tests.name: SATLIB planning
tests.proposed_test: Select bounded planning encodings and assumption queries across horizons.
tests.fairness_and_admission: Solving one horizon is not an optimal planner; retain temporal semantics and decoder checks for returned plans.

tests.name: SATLIB graph coloring
tests.proposed_test: Use flat/morphed graph-coloring CNFs across densities; separately generate small exactly checked graphs.
tests.fairness_and_admission: Color bits and auxiliary counts differ from graph vertices; projected coloring counts must handle color symmetries explicitly.

tests.name: Unweighted model counting competition
tests.proposed_test: Freeze a family-balanced selection from stable releases, retaining easy and hard application classes separately.
tests.fairness_and_admission: Exact arbitrary-precision answers, declared unused variables and independent counters required; hard competition selection is not typical traffic.

tests.name: Projected model counting competition
tests.proposed_test: Use published projection sets and vary assumptions only in a separate modeled-query panel.
tests.fairness_and_admission: Do not replace projected count with total CNF count; use deterministic exact mode and verify adapter support.

tests.name: Weighted model counting
tests.proposed_test: Use rational-weight instances and defined evidence queries from archived weighted tracks.
tests.fairness_and_admission: CM weight support is a new capability gate; exact, approximate and floating-tolerance results get different scoreboards.

tests.name: Package dependency feasibility
tests.proposed_test: Import attributed CUDF examples or operator-provided package requests, checking installability and returned package sets.
tests.fairness_and_admission: aspcud optimization includes preferences; benchmark feasibility alone unless every arm returns the same certified optimum.

tests.name: SMT-LIB QF_BV circuits
tests.proposed_test: Choose bit-vector cases; evaluate original SMT with Z3 and a checked Boolean translation with SAT/CM.
tests.fairness_and_admission: Charge bit-blasting; word width is not total Boolean width; signedness, overflow, shifts and zero-division semantics must match.

tests.name: Biological update-function tables
tests.proposed_test: Extract each model's regulator update functions and request complete local truth vectors.
tests.fairness_and_admission: Network size and local in-degree differ; preserve source/free-input conventions and Booleanization metadata.

tests.name: Synchronous Boolean-network simulation
tests.proposed_test: Evaluate all node updates for the same batches of initial states and fixed step counts.
tests.fairness_and_admission: All nodes read the old state; full transition relations contain current and next-state variables and are a different task.

tests.name: Biological fixed points
tests.proposed_test: Solve conjunctions of each state variable equal to its update function; return count/status/witness in separate cells.
tests.fairness_and_admission: Compare with AEON/native SAT; fixed points are not all attractors, and asynchronous dynamics require a separate implementation.

tests.name: Perturbation and knockout contexts
tests.proposed_test: Apply fixed-variable knockout/overexpression contexts and evaluate or count the same residual functions.
tests.fairness_and_admission: Retain source biological provenance without claiming clinical utility; generated perturbation order is modeled reuse.

tests.name: Static fault-tree top event
tests.proposed_test: Use OpenPSA static AND/OR/NOT/k-of-n trees; compute event truth vectors, existence or counts.
tests.fairness_and_admission: Repeated basic events are the same variable; dynamic gates and common-cause semantics need separate modeling.

tests.name: Fault-tree reliability probabilities
tests.proposed_test: Use exact top-event probability under a declared independence model and evidence updates.
tests.fairness_and_admission: SCRAM exact BDD probability is the comparator; rare-event approximations and truncated cut sets are not exact answers.

tests.name: Small Bayesian-network inference
tests.proposed_test: Start with ASIA, CANCER and EARTHQUAKE; compare evidence likelihood/marginal queries under an audited encoding.
tests.fairness_and_admission: CPTs are conditional probabilities; arbitrary Boolean counts do not implement Bayesian inference. Native elimination is mandatory.

tests.name: Medium Bayesian-network inference
tests.proposed_test: Use CHILD, ALARM, INSURANCE and WATER after small-model conversion tests succeed.
tests.fairness_and_admission: Categorical node count is not Boolean width; preserve one-hot constraints and exact/tolerance contract, including zero-probability evidence.

tests.name: Cedar authorization examples
tests.proposed_test: Use handwritten policies with expected decisions and request contexts; retain an admitted finite Boolean subset.
tests.fairness_and_admission: Preserve forbid precedence, entity membership, missing fields and errors; compare native prepared Cedar as well as cold parsing.

tests.name: Cedar fuzz corpus
tests.proposed_test: Use a fixed sample of upstream generated cases for adapter differential correctness and repeated-request tests.
tests.fairness_and_admission: Corpus generation targets code coverage, not production frequencies; unsupported/error cases cannot silently become deny.

tests.name: OPA policy evaluation
tests.proposed_test: Select documented Boolean policy fragments and benchmark raw, prepared and compiled incumbent paths.
tests.fairness_and_admission: Rego collections, undefined values and external lookups are not free Boolean atoms; charge extraction and preserve result semantics.

tests.name: Packet-classification rules
tests.proposed_test: Generate fixed ClassBench seeds and packet batches; return the first matching action or permitted-set artifact.
tests.fairness_and_admission: Preserve rule order and default action; full packet bit widths generally exceed explicit-table limits.

tests.name: Roaring bitmap query expressions
tests.proposed_test: Run intersections, unions, differences and shared multi-output expressions on real bitmap datasets.
tests.fairness_and_admission: Rows are arbitrary records, not all truth assignments; CM needs a verified batch evaluator. Compare CRoaring, dense words and sorted-set intersection.

tests.name: Feature flags and eligibility rule models
tests.proposed_test: Generate tenant/rule hierarchies, allow/deny conflicts and correlated request attributes with declared distributions.
tests.fairness_and_admission: Distinguish primitive predicate extraction from Boolean combination and include a compiled native/short-circuit evaluator.

tests.name: LDPC parity-check feasibility and count
tests.proposed_test: Use verified parity-check matrices; vary syndrome and erasure/fixed-bit contexts.
tests.fairness_and_admission: H matrices differ from generators; compare packed elimination and M4RI. Counting solutions is not error-correction decoding performance.

tests.name: CRC/LFSR linear constraints
tests.proposed_test: Generate pinned polynomials, bit ordering and observed-output constraints; return rank, consistency and exact count.
tests.fairness_and_admission: Pure affine formulas favor algebraic solvers; identify generic GF(2) benefits separately from CM representation benefits.

tests.name: Structured dense/sparse GF(2)
tests.proposed_test: Sweep dimensions, density, rank deficiency, duplicate rows and contradictions with planted exact ranks.
tests.fairness_and_admission: Dense M4RI and Python packed elimination get the same native rows; AST-to-row conversion is separately charged.

tests.name: Mixed XOR/CNF cryptographic models
tests.proposed_test: Combine parity layers with nonlinear gates; sweep XOR density and nonlinear count using published generator specifications.
tests.fairness_and_admission: These are cryptography-inspired models, not a claim to break real ciphers; include CryptoMiniSat native XOR support.

tests.name: Complete ANF versus rank-only queries
tests.proposed_test: Request full ANF coefficients or a declared rank/decomposition artifact from the same truth functions in distinct lanes.
tests.fairness_and_admission: ANF transform, rank and full decomposition have different outputs; include every transform/conversion and exact artifact verification.

tests.name: Repeated syndrome sessions
tests.proposed_test: Keep a parity-check system fixed while processing distinct RHS values, fixed bits and selected revisions.
tests.fairness_and_admission: Incumbents may reuse factorization; identical-result memoization and changed matrix versions must be represented fairly.

tests.name: Constants, literals and absent variables
tests.proposed_test: Cover true/false, literals, tautologies and unused ambient variables with analytic counts.
tests.fairness_and_admission: Unused basis variables multiply counts; a large declared basis with tiny support is its own stratum.

tests.name: Balanced versus deep expression trees
tests.proposed_test: Match operator counts and effective support while varying depth, fan-in and recursion exposure.
tests.fairness_and_admission: Match nodes rather than nominal generator depth; use independently proved live-variable controls.

tests.name: Shared DAG versus duplicated tree
tests.proposed_test: Generate controlled sharing factors with identical semantics and expose repeated subgraphs.
tests.fairness_and_admission: Include raw recursion, memoization and CSE-flat ladder; a sharing win alone is not CM-specific.

tests.name: Parity and equivalence chains
tests.proposed_test: Generate all-live parity/equivalence functions at each explicit width with known counts.
tests.fairness_and_admission: Native XOR/CDCL and GF(2) are strong scalar baselines; constants from accidental cancellation must be detected.

tests.name: Cardinality and voting rules
tests.proposed_test: Generate at-most, exactly and at-least thresholds, including boundary thresholds.
tests.fairness_and_admission: Use combinatorial binomial counts as an oracle; retain encoding size and auxiliaries for sequential/totalizer controls.

tests.name: Multiplexers and selectors
tests.proposed_test: Vary address bits, data bits, sharing and variable order with a stable selection definition.
tests.fairness_and_admission: Total input width includes address and data; compare BDD natural, interleaved and dynamic orders with ordering costs.

tests.name: Arithmetic Boolean functions
tests.proposed_test: Use adders, comparators and selected multiplier bits; record operand widths and output choice.
tests.fairness_and_admission: Two b-bit operands require up to 2b inputs; include native arithmetic for concrete-assignment tasks.

tests.name: Random 3-CNF density sweep
tests.proposed_test: Generate unique seeded cases across clause/variable ratios 1, 3, 4, 4.3, 5 and 8.
tests.fairness_and_admission: Balance outcomes after recording all draws; ratio 4.3 is a parameter, not a proved threshold for every small n.

tests.name: Horn and 2-CNF controls
tests.proposed_test: Sweep implication graphs, satisfiable/unsatisfiable cases and partial contexts.
tests.fairness_and_admission: Include specialized linear-time SAT controls; easy status does not imply easy model counting.

tests.name: Independent components
tests.proposed_test: Compose disjoint small factors while increasing total variables to 64, 128, 256 and beyond.
tests.fairness_and_admission: Compare factorized counts with native counters and product-of-counts control; never expand the full state space unnecessarily.

tests.name: Overlap and elimination-width ladder
tests.proposed_test: Generate chains, cycles, grids and hub/star CNFs with matched counts of variables/clauses where possible.
tests.fairness_and_admission: Record measured induced width and ordering cost; include deliberately hostile elimination orders and refusals.

tests.name: Auxiliary/projection correctness traps
tests.proposed_test: Create unique-extension gates, nonunique auxiliaries, empty projections and unused selected variables.
tests.fairness_and_admission: E.g. a true visible variable plus a free hidden variable has total count 2 but projected count 1; this must not be conflated.

tests.name: Rewrite and equivalence adversaries
tests.proposed_test: Use absorption, De Morgan, double negation, XOR cancellation and masked mutations with certified outcomes.
tests.fairness_and_admission: All exact methods may exploit simplification; include unchanged negative controls and failed mutation attempts.

tests.name: BDD variable-order sensitivity
tests.proposed_test: Construct paired equality and multiplexer families in grouped/interleaved/random orders.
tests.fairness_and_admission: Charge reorder/search cost; do not report the worst BDD order as its sole comparator or oracle-best order as a deployable selector.

tests.name: Output density and runs
tests.proposed_test: Sweep sparse, dense, clustered and alternating outputs on declared finite universes.
tests.fairness_and_admission: Dense versus compressed artifacts must be normalized or scored by a downstream task; complements mask unused high bits.

tests.name: True 24-32-variable frontier
tests.proposed_test: Construct certified all-live instances at 20, 24, 28, 30 and 32; add a separate low-support ambient ladder.
tests.fairness_and_admission: Use resource preflight, complete packed/stream verification and independent variable-influence checks; sampled equality alone is provisional.

tests.name: Cold versus resident amortization
tests.proposed_test: Measure Q=1,2,4,8,16,64,256,1024 distinct queries with setup charged once per session.
tests.fairness_and_admission: Include cached-result lookup for identical queries and native incumbent preparation reuse; model Q is not observed production Q.

tests.name: Cache pressure and eviction
tests.proposed_test: Use uniform and Zipf-like accesses, working sets below/above capacity, renaming and basis changes.
tests.fairness_and_admission: Hold byte budgets equal, account for caller-held references, and label synthetic traffic explicitly.

tests.name: Version invalidation
tests.proposed_test: Replay genuine source versions with separately modeled query arrivals and occasional no-op edits.
tests.fairness_and_admission: Version history does not reveal query frequency; frozen chronological holdout and independent result checks required.

tests.name: Fresh process and structural reload
tests.proposed_test: Compare resident plans, new engines, fresh processes and checked artifact reloads for identical sessions.
tests.fairness_and_admission: Include imports, dynamic library load, preparation, deserialization and first query; native persistence gets equal opportunity.

tests.name: Complete streaming to real sinks
tests.proposed_test: Deliver ordered packed bytes to file, pipe and slow-reader sinks; sweep 8KiB,64KiB,1MiB,8MiB chunks.
tests.fairness_and_admission: Measure final consumer completion, cancellation and backpressure; lazy iterator creation is not complete evaluation.

tests.name: Concurrency and workspace isolation
tests.proposed_test: Use 1,2,4,8 workers on independent/shared plans with memory pressure and deterministic results.
tests.fairness_and_admission: Verify private mutable scratch, matched CPU quotas, no GIL asymmetry hidden in claims, and no oversubscribed timing lane.

tests.name: Long soak, recovery and refusal
tests.proposed_test: Run bounded sessions with cancellations, refused widths, resource exhaustion and process restarts.
tests.fairness_and_admission: Record leak trends, successful-work throughput and every lost request; a soak is engineering evidence rather than an algorithm speedup.

tests.name: Independent consumer trace
tests.proposed_test: Capture an already-used caller's natural queries, lifetimes, revisions and consumed outputs.
tests.fairness_and_admission: Owner and trace admission required; local metadata-only sampling precedes authorized exact replay. This is the production-savings claim lane.

tests.name: Reconstruct archived SymPy comparison
tests.proposed_test: Replay the historical formulas and pinned source when recoverable; report old timer boundaries and current equivalents.
tests.fairness_and_admission: Historical labels are not trusted as task parity; unrecoverable source/formulas remain unverified and are not regenerated as exact replays.

tests.name: SymPy truth_table API
tests.proposed_test: Fully consume truth_table(..., input=False) into the agreed packed result on small widths.
tests.fairness_and_admission: Include SymPy conversion and generator consumption; narrow per-cell timeouts prevent tiny controls dominating the campaign.

tests.name: SymPy lambdify evaluation
tests.proposed_test: Compile Boolean expressions to NumPy callable and evaluate identical assignment batches; compare cse on/off.
tests.fairness_and_admission: Charge callable compilation/JIT where relevant and normalize constants/scalars; do not include simplification unless requested.

tests.name: SymPy SAT and equivalence
tests.proposed_test: Use satisfiable(F) and satisfiable(XOR(F,G)); compare status or witness against native SAT and CM.
tests.fairness_and_admission: An unevaluated simplify_logic result is unknown for proof purposes; failure to simplify to false does not establish non-equivalence.

tests.name: SymPy simplified SOP/POS
tests.proposed_test: Request simplified SOP/POS from fixed small formulas; compare alternative simplification pipelines under equivalence checks.
tests.fairness_and_admission: CM alone has no matched minimizer here; CM plus the same minimizer is a pipeline arm. Report quality/runtime, not a full-table speed ranking.

tests.name: Espresso and synthesis quality
tests.proposed_test: Use Boolean cover/logic synthesis tasks with equivalent output, literal/gate count, and runtime.
tests.fairness_and_admission: Heuristic and exact minimization are separate guarantees; input preparation and truth-table conversion are charged symmetrically.

tests.name: IWLS2026 published truth tables
tests.proposed_test: Use already-materialized tables for representation loading, queries and a separate logic-synthesis study.
tests.fairness_and_admission: There is no AST-to-table construction to time; undisclosed function origins do not establish application provenance.

tests.name: CM contribution ladder
tests.proposed_test: Compare raw AST, memoized AST, CSE-flat, CM IR, optimized packed masks and the same scalar algorithm from raw versus CM ingress.
tests.fairness_and_admission: Give shared optimizations to every eligible arm. Attribute a gain to the smallest changed mechanism that explains it.
